procedure: 1. Fix the environment record: input sha256 values, toolchain (rustc -vV), profile, patterns, thread counts and input set; keep them constant across runs. 2. After warm-up, time at least 10 runs each of full and scoped operations, collecting median, p95 and peak RSS (usr/bin/time -l or instrumented counters); include owned-bytes and CRC verification costs in the accounting. 3. Report the numbers with the environment; do not carry over earlier 8x-style claims.
pass_criteria: At least 10 timed samples per operation with median/p95/peak RSS recorded; environment and inputs fully identified by hash; owned/CRC costs accounted; no unsubstantiated performance claims.
